FreeDOS 1.4 Floppy Edition - licences of the programs on these disks

This index was compiled for the unemupc98 library from the FreeDOS 1.4
release files. It is not a FreeDOS Project document; the index itself is
dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. The disks and every official
source package are redistributed unmodified.

The disks hold the FreeDOS Floppy Edition installer (x86BOOT.img) and the
packages of the release, stored in a Slicer archive (x86DSK*.img). The
corresponding source of the programs is in the source archive that travels
with this set, freedos-1.4-floppy-src.tar:

  packages/<group>/<package>.zip  the official FreeDOS 1.4 packages, taken
                                  unmodified from the FreeDOS 1.4 LiveCD
                                  (FD14LIVE.ISO); each holds its sources
                                  under SOURCE/ and its licence texts under
                                  DOC/ or SOURCE/
  packages/util/fdbanner.zip      FDBANNER from the FreeDOS 1.4 repository
  installer/FDI-x86/              the Floppy Edition installer, tag
                                  FreeDOS-v1.4 of github.com/shidel/FDI-x86
  installer/FDI/                  the FreeDOS installer settings the
                                  Floppy Edition copies (FDISETUP/SETUP),
                                  tag FreeDOS-v1.4 of github.com/shidel/FDI
  installer/fd-nls/               installer translations and fonts, tag
                                  FreeDOS-v1.4 of github.com/shidel/fd-nls
  builder/                        the FreeDOS release build environment,
                                  tag FreeDOS-v1.4 of gitlab.com/FreeDOS/OS/builder

The licence of each program, read from its own notices: the source headers
of its main program and its licence files, and only where those name no
version, its package's APPINFO/*.LSM "Copying-policy" ("per LSM"). Where a
package's notices differ, the narrowest grant is listed. A GPL notice with no
version is GPL-1.0-or-later.

Installer (boot disk)
  FDI-x86 installer scripts          GPL-1.0-or-later (LICENSE)
  FDI configuration templates        GPL-1.0-or-later (LICENSE)
  fd-nls translations and fonts      GPL-2.0-or-later (README.md:
                                     submissions are "covered by the GNU
                                     General Public License, version 2
                                     [...] or later"); the V8F fonts come
                                     with their .FNT bitmap sources
  FDBANNER                           MIT

Packages
  append, attrib, chkdsk, choice, cpidos, ctmouse, defrag, deltree,
  devload, diskcomp, diskcopy, display, edlin, fdapm, fdhelper, find,
  freecom, gzip, kernel, keyb, keyb_lay, label, lbacache, more, move,
  nansi, nlsfunc, print, recover, sort, undelete
                                     GPL-2.0-or-later ("either version 2
                                     of the License, or (at your option)
                                     any later version", or the same in
                                     the package's README)
  mkeyb                              GPL-2.0-or-later: its license.txt
                                     names the GNU GPL without a version
                                     and adds an exception for executable
                                     packers; its DOS-C files are 2 or later
  edit, fdisk, format, graphics, mem, mirror, mode, replace, tree,
  xcopy, fdimples                    GPL-2.0-only (their sources or licence
                                     files name version 2 alone; FDISK's
                                     README says "version 2 or later", its
                                     MAIN.C "Version 2")
  fc, fdxms, fdxms286                GPL-2.0-only (per LSM; fdxms's
                                     history: "changed to GPL version 2")
  cwsdpmi                            GPL-2.0-only (COPYING.CWS, with the
                                     author's added permission to
                                     distribute the official binaries)
  assign, swsubst                    GPL-1.0-or-later ("either version 1,

  share, unformat                    GPL-1.0-or-later (GPL, no version)
  tree                               also LGPL-2.1-or-later (CATGETS.C) and

  himemx                             (GPL-1.0-or-later OR Artistic-1.0) for
                                     the FD Himem code it derives from;
                                     its own changes are public domain
  jemm                               Artistic-1.0
  comp, debug, fdnpkg, fdinst        MIT
  slicer                             BSD-2-Clause

  exe2bin                            Watcom-1.0
  zip, unzip                         Info-ZIP
  v8power                            GPL (any version) OR BSD-3-Clause OR

                                     README: "the licenses for all others
                                     are in the same spirit as the GNU
                                     FDL"); the viewer under the Express
                                     Software Public License 1.0, below
  fdnet                              FDNET.BAT GPL-1.0-or-later; DHCP.EXE
                                     from mTCP GPL-3.0-or-later (source in
                                     packages/net/mtcp.zip); the NE2000
                                     and PCNTPK packet drivers
                                     GPL-1.0-only ("the Free Software
                                     Foundation, version 1") with public
                                     domain parts; BERNDPCI public domain
  callver                            public domain
  shsucdx, shsufdrv                  freeware with source, below;
                                     SHSURDRV links ZLIBCDRD.LIB, zlib
                                     1.2.3 modified for it: Zlib
  udvd2                              free with source, below

Libraries inside several programs: the kitten and cats message libraries
(choice, ctmouse, diskcopy, fc, find, format, label, mem, more, move, sort,
tree) are LGPL-2.1-or-later; the IO95 (diskcopy, find) and SUPPL (freecom)
libraries are LGPL-2.0-or-later ("either version 2 of the License, or (at
your option) any later version" of the GNU Library General Public License)
and are redistributed here under LGPL-2.1-or-later, which that grant allows.

The cpidos code-page fonts (CPI/*.CPX) are UPX-packed CPI files, the form
their author edits. SOURCE/CPIDOS/SOURCES.TXT reads: "Package of
DISPLAY-type, UPX-compressed CPI files with various DOS codepages. The CPX
files can be uncompressed using NASM. The uncompressed files can be then
modified using free utilities created by Kosta Kostis". UPX's own decoder
(upx -d) restores each CPI file byte for byte; every CPX file carries the
UPX header and the CPI "FONT" header inside it. cpidos's README: "This
software is free software, and is distributed under the GNU-GPL license
version 2.0 or later."

ZLIBCDRD.LIB is zlib 1.2.3 modified for SHSURDRV. The zlib licence asks
that "Altered source versions must be plainly marked as such, and must not
be misrepresented as being the original software"; DOC/SHSUFDRV/ZLIBCDRD.TXT
records the changes as a diff against zlib 1.2.3. The licence obliges no
source.

LicenseRef-FreeDOS-other names these terms, each as its part states it:
  Public domain. callver (CALLVER.ASM): "license: public domain. have
  fun!"; BERNDPCI (BERNDPCI.ASM): "This is public domain software by Eric
  Auer 2007"; HimemX (Readme.txt): "All changes done for HimemX are Public
  Domain"; the public-domain parts of the Crynwr packet drivers, of EDIT
  (for example ASCIITAB.C: "Public Domain, written by Eric Auer") and of
  TREE (Jeremy Davis's findfile).
  Freeware with source. SHSUCDX (SHSUCDX.TXT): "Copyright 2006-2020 Jason
  Hood" and "Freeware."; SHSUFDRV and SHSURDRV (README.TXT): "Copyright
  2005 Jason Hood" and "Freeware."; the shsufdrv package: "Copying-policy:
  Freeware / source code available". Their sources are in the packages.
  UDVD2, by Jack R. Ellis: its package states "Copying-policy: Free
  w/sources" and no other terms; its source, UDVD2.ASM, is in the package.
  Express Software Public License 1.0, the licence of the HTML Help viewer:
  a weak copyleft whose text follows the Mozilla Public License 1.1 section
  for section. Its full text is DOC/HELP/COPYING of
  packages/base/htmlhelp.zip; like the MPL it obliges the source of the
  covered code (its 3.2 "Availability of Source Code"), which is in the same
  package (SOURCE/HTMLHELP/SOURCES.ZIP).

The conjunction of every licence above is:
GPL-1.0-only AND GPL-1.0-or-later AND GPL-2.0-only AND GPL-2.0-or-later
AND GPL-3.0-or-later AND LGPL-2.1-or-later AND MIT AND BSD-2-Clause AND
MPL-2.0 AND Watcom-1.0 AND Info-ZIP AND Artistic-1.0 AND GFDL-1.1-or-later
AND Zlib AND LicenseRef-FreeDOS-other
